hypothesis: Training the r34-accepted spectral-temporal architecture at the full 201 decimated time steps (vs r37's 101) across 4 GPUs will reduce low-resolution train-only calibration relative L2 below 0.5 within 100 exposures per fit record.
expected_mechanism: r37 (101 steps, stride-4 sampling) trains a temporal downsampled view; the dataset schema is 401->201, so max_time_steps 201 uses the native decimation with no extra information loss. DDP-4 is compute infrastructure only (identical seed, manual complex-safe gradient averaging, bit-identical ranks); the single scientific variable is temporal resolution 101->201.
primary_metric: best low-resolution train-only calibration relative L2
failure_signal: Calibration relative L2 above 0.5 after 100 exposures, non-finite prediction, OOM, missing checkpoint, or binding failure rejects temporal-resolution sufficiency without opening confirmation or project validation/test_id.

bindings.tests: training/data tests pass; 4 pre-existing unrelated failures (half-precision CPU, CLI PYTHONPATH, bundle manifest)

rollback: Preserve r34-r37 and all prior artifacts; if rejected, add explicit medium/source conditioning or a learned propagator prior under a new train-only preregistration.
